state.title: git why "text encoding guesser" --no-refresh

part.text:
The `git why` command output shows that the default text-encoding guesser was changed.

Commit `b725bfd` on January 22, 2012, introduced the use of `chardet` for encoding detection when no encoding is provided. The commit message states: "Use chardet for detection when no encoding is provided." This commit is the most direct answer to why the library switched its default text-encoding guesser.

Here's the relevant part of the commit message:
"Use chardet for detection when no encoding is provided."

The switch from `chardet` to something else (as suggested by the prompt) is not evident in the immediate surrounding commits. The most significant change related to encoding detection is the introduction of `chardet` itself.

Therefore, the requests library switched its default text-encoding guesser to `chardet` in commit `b725bfd`.
